description: This file is a shell script that manages WWAN (Wireless Wide Area Network) configurations, including setup and teardown of various protocols (MBIM, QMI, NCM, 3G, direct IP). It loads external scripts, initializes configuration, and handles USB device detection and protocol-specific setup.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Placeholder for MBIM protocol setup, reports missing protocol

methods.description: Placeholder for QMI protocol setup, reports missing protocol

methods.description: Placeholder for NCM protocol setup, reports missing protocol

methods.name: proto_3g_setup
methods.description: Placeholder for 3G protocol setup, reports missing protocol

methods.name: proto_directip_setup
methods.description: Placeholder for direct IP protocol setup, reports missing protocol

methods.name: proto_wwan_init_config
methods.description: Initializes WWAN configuration options such as APN, auth, username, password, etc.

methods.name: proto_wwan_setup
methods.description: Sets up WWAN device, detects USB device, assigns control and data devices, and calls protocol-specific setup functions

methods.name: proto_wwan_teardown
methods.description: Tears down WWAN device, calls protocol-specific teardown functions
